title: Aging behavior of polymeric-fiber based vacuum insulation panels
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29560-29570
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02871J, Paper
Open Access

Jianzhu Ju, Changxi Li, Qunjian Huang
Polymeric fiber VIP achieves ultralow initial thermal conductivity and slow aging. In situ pressure and thermal conductivity tests reveal the aging mechanism of VIP. Aging of polymeric fiber VIP depends on both viscoelasticity and gas permeation.
